module: Manages the eight material sets (letters A to H) of the Track Builder. Each letter corresponds to two scene materials, 'track_editor_<letter>_center' and 'track_editor_<letter>_border'. The module reads and writes their colors, textures (base, specular, normal, center/border decals), glow (glow/emissive) and ground type (groundtype); it can also revert to the original values and return only the values that differ from the defaults.
notes: A material is a table with: baseCenterColor, baseBorderColor, centerColor, borderColor ({r,g,b,a} arrays from 0 to 1), baseTexture, baseTextureN, baseTextureS, centerTexture, borderTexture, centerGlow, borderGlow (booleans), groundtype (ASPHALT by default).
The scene materials are found with scenetree.findObject; the functions fail if 'track_editor_X_center' or '_border' do not exist.
loadMaterial (local) rereads the actual state from the material objects unless skipSet is true, and uses editor.texObj: this assumes the editor is loaded.
Bug: M.loadMaterials is exported but loadMaterials is not defined in the file (the call is commented out), so the field is nil.
resetMaterialsToDefault(letter) calls dump() twice (debug traces left in the code).

currentMaterials.desc: Current state of the materials, keyed by letter (A to H).

loadMaterials.desc: Always nil: reference to an undefined function (bug).

getMaterials.desc: Rereads the 8 materials from the scene and returns, per letter, only the values that differ from the original values (removeDefaults).

setMaterials.desc: Applies several materials: completes each entry with the missing original values (fillDefaults) then calls setSingleMaterial. With no argument, does nothing.

skipSet.desc: If true, does not reread the current state of the scene objects before applying.

setSingleMaterial.desc: Applies a material to the given letter: textures, colors, glow, groundtype, then flush and reload of the center and border materials; updates currentMaterials.

resetMaterialsToDefault.desc: Resets the materials to the original values: all if letter is nil, otherwise only that letter.

letter.desc: Letter 'A' to 'H', or nil for all.
